import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from virtua import Prescription, Chemist, Lab, Admin, Patient

class TestVirtua(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_prescription_received_by_patient(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        patient.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Act
        patient.receive_prescription(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(patient.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(patient.prescriptions[0], prescription)

    def test_prescription_received_by_chemist(self):
        # Arrange
        chemist = Chemist("Local Chemist")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        chemist.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Act
        chemist.receive_prescription(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(chemist.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(chemist.prescriptions[0], prescription)

    def test_prescription_received_by_lab(self):
        # Arrange
        lab = Lab()
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        lab.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Act
        lab.receive_prescription(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(lab.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(lab.prescriptions[0], prescription)

    def test_chemist_provides_medicines_to_patient(self):
        # Arrange
        chemist = Chemist("Local Chemist")
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        chemist.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Act
        chemist.provide_medicines_to_patient(prescription, patient)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(patient.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(patient.prescriptions[0], prescription)

    def test_lab_updates_lab_reports_on_system(self):
        # Arrange
        lab = Lab()
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")
        lab.prescriptions.append(prescription)

        # Act
        lab.update_lab_reports_on_system(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(lab.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(lab.prescriptions[0], prescription)

    def test_admin_populates_speciality_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        specialities = ["Cardiology", "Neurology", "Oncology"]

        # Act
        admin.populate_speciality_database(specialities)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(admin.specialities), 3)
        self.assertEqual(admin.specialities[0], "Cardiology")
        self.assertEqual(admin.specialities[1], "Neurology")
        self.assertEqual(admin.specialities[2], "Oncology")

    def test_admin_links_specialities_to_doctors(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        specialities = ["Cardiology", "Neurology", "Oncology"]
        doctors = ["Dr. Smith", "Dr. Johnson", "Dr. Williams"]

        # Act
        admin.link_specialities_to_doctors(specialities, doctors)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(admin.specialities), 3)
        self.assertEqual(admin.specialities[0], "Cardiology")
        self.assertEqual(admin.specialities[1], "Neurology")
        self.assertEqual(admin.specialities[2], "Oncology")
        self.assertEqual(len(admin.doctors), 3)
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctors[0], "Dr. Smith")
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctors[1], "Dr. Johnson")
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctors[2], "Dr. Williams")

    def test_admin_populates_doctor_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        doctors = ["Dr. Smith", "Dr. Johnson", "Dr. Williams"]

        # Act
        admin.populate_doctor_database(doctors)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(admin.doctors), 3)
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctors[0], "Dr. Smith")
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctors[1], "Dr. Johnson")
        self.assertEqual(admin.doctors[2], "Dr. Williams")

    def test_admin_populates_lab_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        labs = ["Lab 1", "Lab 2", "Lab 3"]

        # Act
        admin.populate_lab_database(labs)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(admin.labs), 3)
        self.assertEqual(admin.labs[0], "Lab 1")
        self.assertEqual(admin.labs[1], "Lab 2")
        self.assertEqual(admin.labs[2], "Lab 3")

    def test_admin_populates_chemist_database(self):
        # Arrange
        admin = Admin()
        chemists = ["Chemist 1", "Chemist 2", "Chemist 3"]

        # Act
        admin.populate_chemist_database(chemists)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(admin.chemists), 3)
        self.assertEqual(admin.chemists[0], "Chemist 1")
        self.assertEqual(admin.chemists[1], "Chemist 2")
        self.assertEqual(admin.chemists[2], "Chemist 3")

    def test_patient_registers_into_system(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")

        # Act
        patient.register_into_system()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(patient.name, "John Doe")
        self.assertEqual(patient.email, "john@example.com")

    def test_confidentiality_constraint(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")
        prescription = Prescription("medication", "dosage", "frequency")

        # Act
        patient.receive_prescription(prescription)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(patient.prescriptions), 1)
        self.assertEqual(patient.prescriptions[0], prescription)

    def test_empty_string_input(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("", "")

        # Act
        patient.register_into_system()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(patient.name, "")
        self.assertEqual(patient.email, "")

    def test_negative_input(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("-John Doe", "-john@example.com")

        # Act
        patient.register_into_system()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(patient.name, "-John Doe")
        self.assertEqual(patient.email, "-john@example.com")

    def test_boundary_input(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")

        # Act
        patient.register_into_system()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(patient.name, "John Doe")
        self.assertEqual(patient.email, "john@example.com")

    def test_exception_handling(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")

        # Act
        try:
            patient.register_into_system()
        except Exception as e:
            self.assertEqual(str(e), "Patient registration failed")

    def test_error_path(self):
        # Arrange
        patient = Patient("John Doe", "john@example.com")

        # Act
        try:
            patient.register_into_system()
        except Exception as e:
            self.assertEqual(str(e), "Patient registration failed")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
